reason: Independently reproduced on Go 1.26.6 with my own non-test fixture (const maxLen = 1e3 used as s[:maxLen], b[0:2.0], s[complex(1,0):3], b[0:2:4.0]): plain build passes, woven build fails with 'float64/complex128 does not satisfy integer' at the customer's own source lines. Generated source shows bounds spliced into generic args, losing index context; an independent go/types probe shows the bounds resolve to int, so the matcher's UntypedFloat/UntypedComplex guard is dead code. Compile-time weaving means DD_IAST_ENABLED cannot avoid it; not documented. Go 1.27.0 could not be tested because an unrelated encoding/json aspect failure blocks the woven build there.
